messages.content: Solo produces JSON válido — sin prosa, sin bloques de markdown.
Produce un array JSON de 5 entradas de libros ficticios. Cada uno tiene los campos: title (string), author (string), year (int 1800-2024), genres (array de 1-3 strings), rating (float 1.0-5.0).

message.content:
<think>The user wants a JSON array of 5 entries of fictional books. Each entry has fields: title (string), author (string), year (int between 1800 and 2024), genres (array of 1-3 strings), rating (float between 1.0 and 5.0). They want me to output only the JSON, no markdown, no prose.

Thus I need to produce a JSON array with 5 objects. Must ensure valid JSON. Provide realistic but fictional titles and authors. Provide random years within 1800-2024. Provide genres array of 1-3 strings. Provide rating float between 1.0-5.0.

Make sure the JSON is valid. Provide no extra text.

Thus the answer: a JSON array with 5 objects.

Potential entries:

1. Title: "The Midnight Garden", author: "Eleanor Vane", year: 1847, genres: ["Mystery", "Gothic"], rating: 4.2.

2. Title: "Echoes of the Void", author: "Marcus Thorne", year: 1999, genres: ["Science Fiction", "Horror"], rating: 3.8.

3. Title: "The Last Ember", author: "Sienna Lark", year: 2021, genres: ["Fantasy", "Adventure"], rating: 4.7.

4. Title: "Silk and Shadows", author: "Jin Ho", year: 1932, genres: ["Historical Fiction"], rating: 4.0.

5. Title: "Quantum Hearts", author: "Aria Frost", year: 2015, genres: ["Romance", "Science Fiction", "Drama"], rating: 3.5.
